prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Predictions have been consistently too high compared to actual noise-corrected results.
No kind of change has been helpful yet, as no tests have won.
No effect was seen for adoption redesign changes across 2 tests.
Evidence is still thin for adoption new_flow, finish new_screen, and sign_in reorder, as each only has 1 test.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, new_flow: -5.1% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- adoption, redesign: -1.3% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- finish, new_screen: -5.7% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- sign_in, reorder: -0.1% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 17.8%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [home, wait_info] Pet Generation Estimated Wait Timer: Displays an explicit time estimate and progress tip carousel while the app generates the pet during the waiting screen. (why: The waiting step has a mean duration of 2336s, causing user drop-off (18.7% lost) due to perceived unresponsiveness.)
1: [sign_in, notification] Account Sync Safeguard Notice: Adds an explicit sync safeguard notice under the sign-in options clarifying that pets are linked permanently to the account. (why: Support received 8 emails regarding missing or reset pets after re-signing into the application.)
2: [adoption, layout] Pick Friend Grid Layout: Changes the pick_friend screen layout to a clean visual grid format for easier side-by-side companion selection. (why: Adoption has the highest friction in the early funnel (60.9% conversion with 89s median / 1017s mean).)
3: [choose_path, copy] Path Choice Value Copy Update: Updates headline and copy on the choose_path screen to highlight speed versus deep personalization. (why: 23.8% of users abandon at path selection, spending a long mean time (514s) deliberating.)
4: [home, wait_info] Pet Generation Background Completion Alert: Enables push desktop notification options so users know they can safely minimize the app during pet creation. (why: Long wait times on the waiting step lead to high drop-offs (18.7%) and desktop launch issues.)
5: [finish, hint] Home Desktop Placement Guidance Hint: Adds inline hints and instructions on the final onboarding screen demonstrating how to locate the pet on screen. (why: 3 support tickets reported pets not showing up on desktop or app failing to open visually.)

scores.note: Targeting 18.7% drop-off from long pet creation wait times.
High evidence from 8 support emails and low effort copy addition.
Adoption step has high drop-off, but past adoption redesigns performed poorly.
Low cost copy tweak addressing path deliberation time.
Helps drop-off during long home waiting step via desktop alerts.
Backed by support tickets and funnel drop-off with simple inline hints.
